title: Task publish resumes its own leftover records worktree after a transient failure
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/publish-6.log: krn task publish exited 70 on a GitHub GraphQL HTTP 503 after it had committed the records in worktree task-records-t-08zbqzn; the retry (.krn/runs/lead/publish-7.log) exited 64 "lane task-records-t-08zbqzn already exists"; the lead shipped the leftover worktree by hand (#merged f13c051).
Outcome: krn task publish resumes from its own leftover records worktree (ships the existing commit) instead of refusing, and retries a transient 5xx once.
Files: src/cli/task-publish.ts, src/ci/ship.ts
Proof: a publish test with a leftover records worktree holding a commit ships it and exits 0.
